purpose: Partial-locator counter-institution tranche: materialize explicitly named courts and human-rights oversight institutions while preserving the repository's unresolved case/institution locator gaps instead of manufacturing precision.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated institution dossier. An explicit institutional proposition may be curated from State-dossier provenance even when the retained external locator is broader, but that gap must remain marked partial.
visualRule: Derived visuals distinguish the explicit curated proposition from the partial source surface and stop at the institution-identity boundary; neither N nor U State context is inherited by the institution.
